summary: Spooky pirates, winter outfits and keyboard controls! Structured changes across 19 entities this patch.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.tldr: /; Updated skin border, Recall VFX and decal VFX to reflect Faker's fifth World Championship title.
champions.gameplayImpact: Ahri was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Updated skin border, Recall VFX and decal VFX to reflect Faker's fifth World Championship title.

champions.name: Braum
champions.tldr: Base health increased to 630 from 610.; Post-stun bonus damage increased to 40% of trigger damage from 20%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Braum is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Post-stun bonus damage
lines.note: Post-stun bonus damage increased to 40% of trigger damage from 20%.

champions.name: Dr. Mundo
champions.tldr: Monster damage cap reduced to 300–600 from 350–650.
champions.gameplayImpact: Dr. Mundo loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Monster damage cap
lines.note: Monster damage cap reduced to 300–600 from 350–650.
